name: MKR locked in the 2017 Maker chief → SKY

steps.title: Approve the chief to take back your IOU tokens
Unlock your MKR from the chief

warnings.text: This MKR was locked for voting in the original 2017 Maker governance contract (used by Sai / single-collateral Dai). It is still yours. First approve the contract to take back your voting receipt (IOU) tokens, then free the MKR, then upgrade it to SKY. If you moved your IOU tokens to another address, the free step fails until they are back.
A delayed-upgrade fee applies and rises over time (about 5% now, stepping up roughly every 3 months). The simulated amount is what you'd get today.

verification.method: eth_simulateV1 via the site engine (lib/scan.js scanChain+analyzeFinding) at latest, one block, traceTransfers, validation=false; status=ready
verification.notes: SAI_ADM (Sai-era DSChief, dai.js mainnet addresses). Holds 1,805.61 MKR (IOU supply 1,804.86); ~1,800.4 MKR sits under two EOAs (1,500 and 300) that never freed after the 2019 chief migration. free() burns the caller's IOU via DSToken.burn(guy,wad), which needs an IOU allowance to the chief: without step 1 free() reverts (verified). No lock-block guard in this version. Also simulated 0xb08e622f…fb38: 300 MKR -> 6,840,000 SKY. Fee = MkrSky fee() 5% (statusCheck).
